title: Orthodontic Benefit Riders Training Note — Valuing Covered Months by the Case's Payment Shape
content:
**Cascade Ortho Rider cases re-established as takeovers: how the covered treatment is valued.** For the recognised covered-treatment fee, how the covered treatment is valued follows the payment shape the rider gives the case.

| Case | How the covered months are valued |
|---|---|
| planned for no more than the rider's lump-sum months (6 on every Cascade Ortho Rider), by the planned treatment months on the new-start entry | the case is paid in one payment at banding, so no treatment after coverage begins is valued and the fee is zero |
| a case that has moved | the covered months before the month of its latest move are valued at the allowed case fee, and the covered months from that month on at the fee of the practice now treating the patient, however many moves came before |
| any other case | every covered month is valued at the allowed case fee |

## Terms

- **Covered months:** the months of treatment still to come when coverage of the case begins.
- **Month of the latest move:** the month of the date on the latest transfer entry.
- **A case that has moved:** a case whose records carry a transfer entry. A case whose latest transfer entry has no months remaining is treated as a case that has not moved for the payment shape.
- **Fee of the practice now treating the patient:** for a case that has moved, the lesser of the allowed case fee and the rate of the practice named on the latest transfer entry (its treatment fee on that entry divided by the months remaining on it and multiplied by the planned treatment months).

## Hypothetical case

- 25 planned treatment months and 18 covered months, coverage beginning in October.
- Allowed case fee: 4,800.00.
- Latest transfer entry dated 5 March, showing a treatment fee of 2,520.00 and 15 months remaining.

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Rate of the new practice | 2,520.00 divided by 15, times 25, is 4,200.00; lesser of that and 4,800.00 is 4,200.00 |
| Covered months before March | 5 (October to February), valued at 4,800.00 |
| Covered months from March on | 13, valued at 4,200.00 |
| Same case planned for 5 months | lump-sum shape, fee zero |
